insights.title: Key Risk Insight
insights.text: 100% of high-risk ecosystems depend on sensitive groundwater aquifers, creating universal vulnerability to over-extraction and contamination that threatens ecosystem water supply across all high-priority protected areas.

insights.title: Resilience Opportunity
insights.text: 150 ecosystems (46% of total) are currently in medium-risk status, representing a critical window for preventive intervention before they transition to high-risk under projected climate change impacts.

insights.title: Urgent Warning
insights.text: The Southeast region shows 58.8% of ecosystems in high-risk status—nearly three times the national average—with dual-stressor exposure from elevated drought and sensitive groundwater requiring immediate regional intervention.

insights.title: Positive Signal
insights.text: The Northeast region demonstrates significantly lower vulnerability (4.3% high-risk vs. 20.1% national average), providing a model for resilience factors that can be replicated in other regions to reduce overall ecosystem water stress.
